title: Reproducible conditional elastic bound comparison
$comment: Structural validation only. visualization.validate_comparison also rebuilds canonical engine values, checks, versions, IDs and metadata. Embedded schemas are snapshots of release contracts.

numerical_policy.const: canonical engine rounded outputs; not certified outward-rounded endpoints

scientific_verification.const: software tests and equation cross-checks; not independent scientific peer review

instance.title: Materials Boundaries instance v1
instance.$comment: Additional runtime constraints: finite float-representable numbers (reject lexical underflow); unique phase IDs; known fraction sum <=1+1e-12; complete fraction sum within 1e-12 of 1. Missing or null observations represent unknown. Literature-model runtime checks require source/phase reference integrity, explicit condition bases consistent with unknown values, and K/G agreement with the fixed E/nu conversion (relative tolerance 1e-12).

index_range.description: Conditional mathematical index range, distinct from its definition. Unbounded is explicit, never null/unknown or a nonfinite JSON number. Only reviewed family ranges are admitted.

hydrostatic_compressibility_contract.description: Closed hydrostatic-stress science: fixed-tensor spectral range is distinct from unrestricted tensor-class range; no evaluator.
